QF.id: VB Fund Distribution and Channel Management_24

question.text: Which of the following is NOT a valid distribution channel for mutual funds?

answer.text: Unauthorized agents selling door-to-door without ARN
Stock exchange platforms like BSE StAR MF

explanation.text: The Logic: Unregistered or unauthorised agents are not eligible to sell or market mutual funds because NISM certification, AMFI registration with an ARN, KYD completion, and empanelment are compulsory prerequisites for distribution. The Trap: Bank branches with ARN-registered staff, AMC websites (Direct Plan), and stock exchange platforms such as BSE StAR MF are all listed valid channels in the workbook — the disqualifier is the absence of valid registration and certification, not the channel type itself. Note: The workbook frames this as a regulatory eligibility issue tied to certification, registration, KYD and empanelment; broader fraud/illegality language beyond eligibility should not be assumed from the source.
